Dell D750E-S6 750W Power Supply – Reliable Performance for Dell PowerEdge Servers


Upgrade your Dell server with the Dell D750E-S6 750W Power Supply Unit, designed to deliver stable and efficient power for enterprise workloads. This hot-swappable, 80 PLUS Platinum certified PSU ensures exceptional performance, energy savings, and long-term reliability for mission-critical data centers.


Key Specifications


  • Model: Dell D750E-S6
  • Power Output: 750 Watts
  • Input Voltage: 100–240V AC, 50/60Hz
  • Efficiency Rating: 80 PLUS Platinum (Up to 94% efficiency)
  • Form Factor: Hot-swappable internal power supply
  • Connector Type: Proprietary Dell server interface
  • Compatibility: Supports Dell PowerEdge R630, R730, R730XD, R530, T630, and similar models
  • Cooling: Integrated smart fan for temperature-controlled airflow


Why Choose the Dell D750E-S6 PSU


  • Designed for high-performance Dell PowerEdge servers
  • Energy-efficient operation reduces power costs and heat output
  • Hot-swappable design allows easy replacement without downtime
  • Built-in protection against overload, short circuit, and overvoltage
  • Trusted by IT professionals for data center reliability


Ideal for


  • Dell PowerEdge server upgrades or replacements
  • Enterprise data centers and cloud environments
  • System integrators and IT infrastructure deployments
